what.text: This page follows refugees from Serbia and Kosovo in all host countries combined, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 29665 refugees from Serbia and Kosovo.
France hosts the largest share, 62.4%, followed by Germany, Switzerland and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Kosovo territory in Serbia with the UCK in 1998 and 1999, at war level.
It also records armed conflict over Croatia territory in 1991 and 1992 and over Slovenia territory in 1991.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1969 at 130 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 327582, at the end of 2002, and the main years of displacement in the data are 1999 and 2002 to 2010.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
UNHCR reports Serbia and Kosovo as one origin; these are year-end totals summed over every host country.
